title: Xiangqi Endgame Puzzles
description: Solve legendary Chinese Chess endgame masterpieces—calculate sharp chariot sacrifices, double-cannon checkmates, and clever knight forks.
controls: Tap a red piece and choose a highlighted square to deliver forced checkmate in the classic endgame puzzle.

zh-CN.title: 象棋经典残局
zh-CN.description: 国粹烧脑精品象棋经典残局：收录海量古谱名局与街边绝杀残局，弃车保帅步步将军，棋艺瞬间精进！
zh-CN.controls: 点击红方棋子选择落点，算准步数步步紧逼绝杀黑方老将即可破解残局。
